trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read. Denials are all substantive: 'No third channel exists' (End(A⊗A) has R-rank 2, so exactly two central idempotents); 'No free parameters are introduced'; 'It disagrees with the bare formula at every other q'; 'Neither is established'. Each is a checkable claim rather than emphasis-by-denial. The one borderline case (the three-item denial after 'topological invariant') is recorded under trap-triples instead.

trap-triples.evidence: 'At the fundamental level, no contour integrals, no factors of $2\pi i$, and no renormalisation-group running are required.' - a reflex three-item denial list immediately after the sentence it restates ('These results turn $\alpha_{EM}$ into a topological invariant of the Bring fibration'). Items 1 and 2 are not independent: factors of $2\pi i$ are what contour integrals produce, so the third item is padded to reach three. Only 'no renormalisation-group running' carries content the preceding sentence does not.
trap-triples.notes: Structural (physics claim at stake), not edited. The substantive numbered list of three structural results earlier in the block is a genuine enumeration and passes.
